description: Returns the companies in the S&P 500, a Russell index or a sector on a given date, including members that later left or delisted, with CIK, ticker, name, sector, industry and a confidence label, plus the full member count. Use this when the user asks who was in an index on a past date or whether a company was a member then. It covers current and former S&P 500 companies, and a long list arrives in pages of at most 250 rows.

as_of_basis.description: Which dates decide membership: effective (default, when a change took effect) or announcement (when it was announced), e.g. announcement.

as_of_date.description: Date the membership applies to, YYYY-MM-DD; omit for the current universe, e.g. 2022-12-30.

include_share_classes.description: true returns one row per share class instead of one per company; defaults to false, e.g. true.

index.description: Index to list: sp500, russell1000, russell2000 or russell3000; omit for no index filter, e.g. sp500.

is_active.description: true keeps only companies still trading today, which drops members that later delisted; omit to keep all, e.g. true.

limit.description: Maximum number of members to return, 1 to 3500; defaults to 100, e.g. 505.

offset.description: Rows to skip when paging through a long list; defaults to 0, e.g. 250.

sector.description: Sector name to match, case-insensitive partial match, e.g. Technology.

name: get_pit_universe

_meta.description: Provenance envelope — data lineage for every MCP response

data_quality.description: Server-side invariants run on this response

fundamentals_as_of.description: Use THIS — not `last_updated` — when telling a user how current the cross-sectional fundamentals are. The snapshot is republished on every weekday price refresh while the statements are carried forward unchanged, so `last_updated` can be far more recent than the numbers it sits next to. It is a floor for a single filer, not a ceiling: a filer with a live partition receives its filing, facts and ratios intraday (minutes after EDGAR dissemination), so an entity-scoped read may carry a filing newer than this; cross-sectional ranks (factor scores, earnings signals) refresh with the weekly bulk export.

pit_safe.description: true iff a zero-look-ahead point-in-time cut was applied to every returned figure

price_as_of.description: ISO timestamp when the price surfaces were last refreshed.

truncation.description: Set when fewer rows were returned than requested — explains why and points to a remedy
Present only when the inline-row cap withheld rows. Page with `next_offset` (keep the same `limit`) or pull the full set via get_compute_ready_stream.
